notes: Spec ambiguity resolved in favour of the exact 200 X x 300 Y x 100 Z mm OUTER rim envelope, 2-degree draft, 3 mm normal wall thickness, and a 6 mm outward rim overhang (4 mm thick). These jointly imply a 188 x 288 mm wall top and approximately 181.016 x 281.016 mm wall base; the spec's approximate 193 x 293 mm base cannot coexist with an outward 6 mm rim inside that envelope. Ribs: four on EACH long side and two on EACH short side, 3 mm wide and 5 mm projection. Handle is a real 80 x 25 R10 through-cut on +Y; its nominal upper edge is Z85 (15 below top). Opposite -Y card pocket is 75 x 35, 1 mm deep, with a fitted white BIN-A07 card and retaining rails. Nominal 4 mm floor has 3 mm underside waffle recesses, leaving a 1 mm skin in each recess. Task-prescribed collision is nine separate convex pieces: floor, four drafted walls, four rim bars. It intentionally fills the handle and underside recesses and omits narrow ribs and label details, so the general 1 mm surface approximation rule cannot apply to these explicitly simplified features. Blue/grey are texture-only variants on the identical mesh and UV atlas; label colours stay fixed. preview_label.png shows the opposite short side; preview_grey.png shows the grey variant. Scene placement is metadata only; the robot should transfer the two small parts, not grasp the 200 mm bin. All coordinates are metres with Z up, front -X, common bottom-centre origin. Visual export is triangulated with normals and a nonoverlapping Smart UV 66-degree atlas. Albedo: 64-sample CPU Cycles diffuse colour * (0.4 + 0.6 * AO), linear light to 8-bit sRGB; no direct light or highlights. Full procedural Principled PBR is retained in source.blend. Generated with Blender 5.2.0 LTS. Task 13 compact OBJ exception: positions use 5 decimal metres where safe; necessary vertices retain up to 6 decimals to preserve nonzero triangles, strict collision convexity and the 0.005 mm Euclidean movement bound. Independent fixed-5 rounding cannot satisfy all three. Normals/UVs use 4 decimals; every original triangle, position index and per-corner attribute value is retained. Equal rounded UV records share indices and visual OBJ indices use shorter equivalent relative notation. No collision remeshing, reindexing or simplification. Task 13 delivery: baked albedos are Lanczos-downsampled to at most 1024 px except the unchanged-resolution factory-floor repeat tile; previews are 512 square. PNG encoding uses RGB8 or reviewed 256-colour Floyd-Steinberg palettes; source artwork pixels and source.blend are retained. Shared PNG paths resolve from this prop folder.
